title: Behavioral Convergence Without Representational Convergence: Persistent Training-History Dependence in Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.37836v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural networks trained toward the same final objective can reach similar predictive performance while retaining internal representations shaped by earlier training history. We study this effect using controlled sequential-training experiments in which paired convolutional networks start from identical weights, experience reversed task orders, and then receive the same deterministic common-relaxation distribution. Across 20 paired MNIST runs, 16 satisfy a predeclared behavioral-matching criterion, yet their matched representations retain a mean history score of 0.139 (95% bootstrap CI: 0.127-0.153) and approximately 3.1% prediction disagreement. Extending common relaxation to 50,000 optimizer updates does not erase the measured difference: across five paired seeds, the representation-history score remains 0.190 (95% bootstrap CI: 0.161-0.219) at the end of the measured horizon while the mean accuracy gap is only 0.18 percentage points. F

translated_title: 行为收敛而表征不收敛：神经网络中持续存在的训练历史依赖性
translated_abstract: 朝向同一最终目标训练的神经网络可以达到相似的预测性能，同时保留由早期训练历史塑造的内部表征。我们通过受控的顺序训练实验研究这一效应：成对的卷积网络从完全相同的权重出发，经历相反的任务顺序，然后接受相同的确定性共同松弛分布。在20组配对的MNIST实验中，有16组满足预先声明的行为匹配准则，但其匹配的表征仍保持平均历史分数0.139（95%自助法置信区间：0.127–0.153）以及约3.1%的预测分歧。将共同松弛扩展到50,000次优化器更新并不能消除所测得的差异：在五组配对随机种子中，在测量范围结束时表征-历史分数仍为0.190（95%自助法置信区间：0.161–0.219），而平均准确率差距仅为0.18个百分点。
tldr: 该研究通过受控的顺序训练实验证明，即使神经网络在行为上几乎完全收敛到相同的预测性能，其内部表征仍持续保留早期训练历史的印记，且这种依赖性无法通过延长共同松弛训练来消除。
en_tdlr: Neural networks that behaviorally converge to near-identical predictive performance persistently retain internal representations shaped by their earlier training history, and this dependence survives even extended common-relaxation training.
